# Synthetic skill (TEST ONLY)

Marker: SHOULD_ONLY_APPEAR_AFTER_SKILL_READ_7F91

Use the Python package `locus_test_plugin` for this capability.

This file is the immutable DEFAULT SOURCE of the synthetic skill
definition. Tests inject it into the SkillSourceStore; the bytes an
enabled capability materializes under
/home/locus/.skills/<capability-id>/synthetic-skill.skill start as an
exact copy and afterwards diverge independently per capability.
